rows.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for being unable or partly able to hear.

example.english: I have been deaf since I was little.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 zau6 lung4 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone refuses to heed advice or will not take what others say on board, not for physical hearing loss.

example.english: You are deaf to everything I say; there is no point talking to you.
example.traditional: 你成日都聽唔入耳，講咩都冇用。
example.jyutping: nei5 seng4 jat6 dou1 teng1 m4 jap6 ji5 gong2 me1 dou1 mou5 jung6

rows.note: Use this attributive construction for something belonging to or associated with the Deaf community, such as its culture or organizations.

example.english: Culture in the deaf community is worth everyone learning about.
example.traditional: 聾人界嘅文化值得大家了解。
example.jyutping: lung4 jan4 gaai3 ge3 man4 faa3 zik6 dak1 daai6 gaa1 liu5 gaai2
